name: Vertex Display: Remote Desktop
summary:
Vertex Display is a remote desktop and multi-monitor workspace for Quest. Mirror and control your Mac, Windows PC and Android phone in VR, and stay productive without taking off your headset.

Connect to your Mac, Windows PC and Android phone at the same time and place their screens anywhere around you. Write code on your Mac, browse on your PC and check your phone — all without taking off your headset.
